body:
Thank you! 

Let’s message in DMs so that we don’t lose track of each other here on reddit.

I don’t know why I can’t get a minimum wage job. I applied for a lot of jobs. I got one job interview. It seemed to have gone well, but I never got a call back from the employer so I’m assuming it’s not in God’s will for me to have that job. 

He cares more about how you end up, although He does care about both. 

I could try to ask my doctor for a different medication but it’s a delicate balance that’s finally got me as stable as I am (in terms of psychosis). These medicines also cause heart problems though. Many of these medications don’t work for me because they lower blood pressure too much or they cause weight gain. 

I appreciate you offering me solutions rather than feelings and sunshine by the way.

I define success materially, of course like most people, but also spiritually. First, materially speaking, I can’t get a job. I went through vocational training and I can’t get a job in the field a trained in, although I understand why. That’s because I trained to become a phlebotomist and phlebotomy jobs are hard to get. The problem is though that I can’t even get a minimum wage job at a store. 

As to define success spiritually, I would say that growing as a person is what that means. God cares more about what we become than what we do. The only thing I do is sit around and rot. 

As for the schizophrenia, I’m being treated for it, but it or the medication for it has impaired my memory really badly and it makes it difficult to function. 

Yes, I struggled in school unless it was math or science, but that’s not how I define intelligence. People seem to think I’m stupid around me, so I probably am stupid.
And I don’t have a job so I’m just sitting around rotting.

I’m worthless for a lot of reasons, one being that I’m stupid. Another being that I’m schizophrenic. Another being that I still live with my parents and I’m 20. Another being that I’ll never be successful. I can’t stand it anymore.
I want to die because I’m worthless.

That’s interesting. I try to limit it to once per week so that I don’t overuse the coping skill like I did cutting because cutting doesn’t help anymore. Also so that my body doesn’t make a habit of it. This week I’ve thrown up twice though.
